response.justification: While the candidate has extensive software development experience across multiple languages and domains, there is no evidence of professional C++ development on Windows platforms or direct experience in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking systems — both mandatory requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience with modern technologies and DevOps practices
Demonstrated ability to lead and contribute to open-source and complex systems
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops and public talks
concerns: No visible professional C++ experience on Windows platform as required
Lacks domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
SQL experience is listed but not contextualized in financial systems or high-volume trading environments
